homonyms.basis: The census row carries no disambiguation field. No card is a homonym: every card concerns the index. 'Anthropic User Index (AUI)' (the Reddit card) is a misnaming of the index's Anthropic AI Usage Index, not another entity (F18, marked contradicts_primary). 'AEI' (an alias in the census) is ambiguous outside the record and was not used as a traversal alias. The distinct entities below are named by the field or the census beside the index and are never senses of its name.
